obx_welcome_desc: This quick tour walks you through creating your first substance, a cycle, and a dose adjustment — step by step — and shows you the calendar.
obx_navmystack_desc: Manage your substances here. Tap “My Stack” at the bottom.
obx_openpep_desc: Create your first substance. Tap “+ New” in the top right.
obx_pepname_desc: Enter the substance name (e.g. BPC-157). You can also pick from known names.
obx_pepcolor_desc: Pick a color — it identifies the substance in lists and charts.
obx_pepmg_desc: How much active compound (mg) does the vial contain?
obx_pepliquid_desc: How many ml of solvent did you add? This is used to calculate the concentration.
obx_peprecon_desc: When did you reconstitute the vial? This is the starting point for shelf life.
obx_pepexpiry_desc: Choose a shelf life or enter custom days — you’ll be warned before it expires.
obx_pepvials_desc: How many vials do you still have raw/unmixed in reserve? 0 is fine — if you are reconstituting your only vial right now.
obx_pepbatch_desc: Optional: batch number for your own tracking.
obx_pepsource_desc: Optional: where you sourced this substance.
obx_pepdoc_desc: Optional: upload a certificate of analysis or an invoice as PDF or image.
obx_pepnotes_desc: Optional: your own notes about this substance.
obx_pepsave_desc: Everything look good? Save the substance.
obx_opencyc_desc: A cycle schedules your dose, frequency, and reminders. Tap “+ Add Cycle”.
obx_cycname_desc: Optional: Give the cycle a name (e.g. "Cut 2024").
obx_cycunit_desc: Choose the unit for the dose.
obx_cycmethod_desc: How will this cycle be administered?
obx_cycfreq_desc: How often? Daily, every 2nd day, specific weekdays, etc.
obx_cycinterval_desc: Every how many days should the intake occur?
obx_cycweekdays_desc: Select the days of the week for the intake.
obx_cycdates_desc: Start date (required) and an optional end date.
obx_cycintake_desc: What time of day? Morning, noon, evening, or a custom time — used as the basis for reminders.
obx_openesc_desc: Plan a future dose adjustment. Tap “Add dose adjustment”.
obx_escamount_desc: What dose should apply from this point?
obx_escwhen_desc: Fixed date, after X days, or after X weeks?
obx_escdetail_desc: Set the exact point in time for the adjustment.
obx_navcal_desc: The calendar shows your daily schedule. Tap “Calendar” at the bottom.
obx_calshow_desc: Upcoming intakes appear here. Tap a day to see the details.
obx_simconfirm_desc: This is how you confirm a due intake. Tap "Confirm" — a sheet will open. This is a practice run, nothing is saved.
obx_finish_desc: You now know the full flow. You can restart the tour any time from your profile.
obx_peppk_desc: For known substances we automatically link a pharmacokinetic profile — the basis for the blood-level simulation.
obx_sim_sheet_hint: When did you actually take it?
obx_sim_time_hint: Adjust the time if needed — it is pre-filled with the planned intake time.

my_stack_tracking_curve_explained: From the strength, the time of day and the substance’s PK profile — its stored absorption and elimination rates — the app works out the curve between intakes.
my_stack_ingredients_intro: Usually a single active ingredient — it is already filled in. A combination product gets one line per ingredient.
my_stack_ingredients_next: In the next step you state, for each ingredient, how much of it one product unit holds — the figure on the package. Only then can the app count in milligrams instead of capsules.
my_stack_strength_hint_per_unit: How much active ingredient is in ONE unit? Enter the figure from the packaging. Example: 500 mg per 1 capsule. The product quantity is already set to 1 — change it only if the packaging states it differently. Not a dosage recommendation.
my_stack_strength_hint_per_volume: Enter the concentration as printed on the label. Example: 250 mg per 1 ml. Not a dosage recommendation.
my_stack_strength_hint_reconstituted: A powder vial (peptide) is dissolved before the first intake — the reconstitution. On the left, how much active ingredient is in the vial; on the right, how much solvent you add. Example: 10 mg in 2 ml gives 5 mg/ml. If the vial is already liquid, both figures are on the label. Not a dosage recommendation.
my_stack_strength_hint_per_mass: How much active ingredient is in a given quantity of product? Enter what is shown on the packaging. Example: 50 mg per 1 g. Not a dosage recommendation.
my_stack_strength_hint_vial_solution: Enter the concentration as printed on the label. Example: 250 mg per 1 ml. If your vial holds a powder you dissolve first, pick “Peptide” as the category — then the step asks for the solvent instead. Not a dosage recommendation.

ai_consent_point_purpose: Only to read it. TYD does not store the file.

pk_stat_peak_sub: When the most active substance is in the blood after the last injection.
pk_stat_half_life_sub: After {{h}} h, half has been cleared. After {{h2}} h it is 75 %, and after {{h5}} h the substance is practically gone. The longer the half-life, the less often you need to dose.
pk_stat_tmax_sub: After the injection it takes about {{h}} h for the substance to reach its highest level in the blood. Only from this point are you at maximum effect.
pk_stat_bioavailability_sub: {{pct}} % of the injected amount reaches the bloodstream. For subcutaneous injection (SC) this value is typically high.
pk_stat_vd_sub: Indicates how widely the substance spreads into body tissue.
pk_stat_vd_high: High value — it is stored heavily in tissue, which often explains a longer duration of effect.
pk_stat_vd_low: Low value — it stays mainly in the blood.
pk_stat_ke_sub: Each hour, {{pct}} % of the remaining substance is cleared. Small value = slow clearance = long duration of effect.
pk_sim_subtitle: See at a glance when your peptide takes effect and when it has been cleared again
pk_sim_disclaimer: All values are based on pharmacological models and are estimates — not medical advice.
pk_history_hint: 7-day window with real intakes · swipe to scroll
pk_manual_intro: Simulate the theoretical course of a single dose — choose substance, dose and route. The values are estimates based on average pharmacological data.
pk_field_substance_tip: Choose the substance you want to simulate. The pharmacokinetic data (half-life, Tmax) is loaded automatically.
pk_no_profiles: No PK profiles yet. Add them in the admin panel.
pk_field_dose_tip: The amount you inject. Tip: check your active cycle for your usual dose.
pk_field_unit_tip: mcg = micrograms (smaller), mg = milligrams (larger), IU = international units (for HGH/HCG)
pk_field_route_tip: SC = subcutaneous (under the skin, slower), IM = intramuscular (into the muscle, somewhat faster)
pk_curve_sub: Relative active substance level in % (normalized to peak = 100 %)
pk_results_intro: What the simulation means for {{name}} — in simple terms.
pk_res_peak_explain: The maximum active substance level you reach with this dose — normalized to 100 %. All other values are shown relative to it.
pk_res_tmax_explain: After the injection it takes about {{h}} hours for the substance to reach its highest level in the blood. Only from this point are you at maximum effect.
pk_res_half_explain: After {{h}} hours, half of the substance has been cleared. After {{h2}} h it is 75 %, and after {{h5}} h it is practically completely eliminated. The longer the half-life, the less often you need to dose.
pk_res_duration_explain: Once the level drops below 10 %, the effect is negligible. This gives you a rough idea of how long a dose is actually active.
pk_res_f_explain: {{pct}} % of the injected amount actually reaches the bloodstream. The rest is broken down before it takes effect. For subcutaneous injection (SC) this value is typically high.
pk_res_vd_high: High value (> 1 L/kg) — the substance is stored heavily in tissue, not just in the blood. This often explains a longer duration of effect.
pk_res_vd_low: Low value — the substance stays mainly in the blood.
pk_res_accum_explain: With regular dosing at your chosen interval, the steady-state level is {{f}} times as high as after the first dose.
pk_res_accum_strong: That is strong accumulation — the substance builds up considerably.
